messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: Paging oncall — multiple 502 responses from embeddings service (eu-dedicated-1) affecting customer LumenBridge. Error rate spike @ 17:23 UTC. Paging maya_oncall. https://redwood.ops/alerts/1750005432 :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: Taking it. Looking at pod restarts and recent deploys. Will post quick mitigation in 2 mins.

ryan.sre: @maya_oncall quick check — heap OOMs or proxy 502s? Can you grab last 30s envoy logs and `kubectl logs` for embeddings-svc?

maya_oncall: grabbing logs now. initial grep shows backend 502 from kv-cache miss + model worker timeouts. Pushing a rolling restart for the embeddings pool (eu-dedicated-1).

priya.cs: Noted. LumenBridge contacts need a concise status update and contact routing. They’re high-touch — primary AM is Sara Holt. I’ll stand by for the message to send externally.

zack-ic: Drafting internal and external text. Internal ops checklist below and a customer-facing blurb. Please review edits.

zack-ic: Internal checklist (short):
- Confirmed impacted cluster: eu-dedicated-1
- Scope: embeddings generation (batch + realtime) for tenant LumenBridge; other tenants may see increased latency
- Immediate mitigation: rolling restart of embeddings workers + temporary routing to fallback quantized model variant (emb-small-v2) for affected requests
- Owner: maya_oncall (oncall SRE)
- Escalation: ryan.sre (infra lead)

zack-ic: Customer-facing blurb (short) — feel free to trim: 
```
Hi Sara,

We’re investigating an issue causing intermittent 502s for embeddings generation in the EU-dedicated cluster used by LumenBridge. Our engineers have identified a backend worker timeout and are performing a rolling restart while routing traffic to a fallback model to reduce errors.

Impact: Some embedding requests may return errors or take longer than usual.
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to a lower-latency fallback model; we expect error rates to decline within ~10 minutes.
Next update: 17:40 UTC or sooner.

If you need immediate assistance, contact: Sara Holt (AM) or priya.cs@redwood.com.
```

priya.cs: Looks good — please add a line about retries on our side for in-flight requests (we’ll auto-retry up to 3x). Also include the customer’s escalation contact: +1-415-555-0199.

ryan.sre: Rolling restart started. Pushed a temporary autoscaler tweak to add 2 warm workers; routing rule applied to send new requests to emb-small-v2 for LumenBridge. Watcher set on error-rate metric.

incident-bot: Action logged: restart_job(embeddings-pool, eu-dedicated-1) — initiated by maya_oncall at 17:25:05 UTC.

statusbot: Proposed status page update: 
"Investigating: Customers on eu-dedicated-1 experiencing elevated errors for embeddings generation. We're performing restarts and routing to a fallback model. Affected customers include LumenBridge (enterprise). Updates every 15 minutes until resolution."

maya_oncall: Error rate dropping from 18% -> 4% after routing change. Some backlog still draining. Keeping oncall for 30m.

zack-ic: Finalize external message with Priya edits, send via AM channel, and publish status update. Also add tailored contact routing snippet for the account team (copy below into helpdesk ticket):
"Account: LumenBridge
Primary AM: Sara Holt — sara@lumenbridge.com / +1-415-555-0199
Secondary: Jorge Ruiz (Eng lead) — jorge@lumenbridge.com
Internal owner: priya.cs / maya_oncall / ryan.sre"

priya.cs: Sending to Sara now and will log the outreach in Salesforce. Thanks team.

statusbot: Status page update published (draft id: s-1750005432).

maya_oncall: Leaving a note for postmortem: investigate KV cache miss pattern and consider increasing warm worker buffer on dedicated clusters with high enterprise tail latency.

zack-ic: Good work. If error rate stays <5% for 30m we’ll demote to advisory and close the page update.

priya.cs: Customer confirmed reduced errors and appreciates the proactive routing. Closing external loop after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
